title: Eleven floors
body: The memo board: Reminder — the Municipal Annex has eleven (11) floors. Any employee reporting a twelfth (12th) floor should be referred to HR. — M.

choices.label: Refer yourself to no one. It's eleven.

outcome.text: Eleven. You can count to eleven. The elevator panel agrees, tonight.

choices.label: Walk to the elevator. Look for a twelfth button.

outcome.text: There is a blank where 12 would be. It is slightly warmer than the panel around it.
